8th Pay Commission Report Expected in 2027, Salary Hike Uncertain

The 8th Pay Commission's report, which will determine salary and pension increases for government employees, is anticipated in 2027. Details regarding the extent of salary hikes and pension adjustments remain uncertain, with employees facing a wait for the report's findings.
